name: research-relay-controller
description: Plan, assign, review and iterate research tasks through GitHub Issues and Pull Requests across multiple coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate research through GitHub task issues, experiment pull requests, evidence-based acceptance and next-step decisions. Use the existing authorized GitHub connector when available.
defaultPrompt: Use Research Relay to create an evidence-based research task Issue in my GitHub repository.
Review this GitHub experiment PR against its task Issue and either accept it or write actionable rework feedback.
Summarize the current research stage from GitHub Issues and PRs, then propose the next smallest testable task.
